_what_this_is: THE RATCHET. Only a human commit moves these numbers: the gate asserts observed >= floor, and a second check asserts floor(head) >= floor(base), so 'delete the assertion and lower the number in the same commit' is not available.
_slack_rule: If observed ever exceeds a floor, raise the floor in the same human commit that added the assertions - slack is deletable coverage. See references/validation-harness.md.
